name: wildlife
title: Wildlife: animals on our roads

sources.name: idfg_roadkill
sources.credit: Idaho Department of Fish and Game

storage: Small: IDFG's roadkill reports in the ring go into core's raw.record, one row per report and per changed version: about 9,300 at the first run (roughly 5-10 MB with indexes), then a few new reports and corrections a day (a few KB). Each daily run reads every report in the ring (about 5 MB before gzip) and moves last_seen on the unchanged ones.
ethics: Road network, not people: IDFG's free-text note (it may hold personal details), its undocumented path (it may point to a photo, never fetched) and any field the layer adds later are dropped at ingest; fields are kept by allow-list, and the layer has no reporter identity. No licence is stated, so the reports stay internal or are published only as aggregates, crediting IDFG, and a courtesy note to IDFG is due (docs/17 Q17). Sensitive taxa follow the core sensitivity rules (Q21): no points, cells of 0.2 degrees or coarser. Never query IDFG's Wildlife_Conflicts_public service.
